'''Khoury's father''' (Japanese: '''カズナリの父''' ''Kazunari's father'') is a minor recurring character who first appeared in ''[[DP143|An Egg Scramble!]]''.

He, [[Khoury|his son]], and {{an|Lyra}} traveled to [[Sinnoh]] and set up the [[Johto Festival]] in order to get Sinnoh {{pkmn|Trainer}}s interested in the [[Johto]] region. He also hoped that Khoury would gain some valuable information on Sinnoh Pokémon and was in charge of the [[Moomoo Milk]] stand. He gave {{Ash}}, {{an|Dawn}}, and {{an|Brock}} some ice cream made from Moomoo Milk. Later, he judged the battle between [[Dawn's Piplup]] and Lyra's {{p|Chikorita}} during the festival.

Near the end of the episode, Lyra and Khoury persuade him to let them travel with Ash and {{ashfr}} for a while, with Lyra wanting to see the [[Lilypad Town]] [[Pokémon Contest]] and Khoury wanting to learn more about {{pkmn|breeding}} from Brock.

Before returning to Johto with Lyra and Khoury in ''[[DP147|Bagged Then Tagged!]]'', he gave a [[Pokégear]] to {{an|Brock}}.
